correctness.rationale: Explicit flux/subgradient parametrization and strictly convex minimizer equations. For m<=3, exact constrained quadratic optimization gives common tie flux z=-a/(k+1); equal hub/tied leaf components establish MINSUB, and polyhedrality invokes verified Burger et al. Theorem 5 for flow=prox and autonomous semigroup. For m=4 and 5, exact rational KKT vectors verify P_1/2(y), P_1/2(P_1/2(y)) and P_1(y), with gaps 1/4 and 1/2. Opposite ±10 appended pairs cancel hub flux and remain saturated, extending both cases to every m>=4. The packaged checker replays finite exact certificates; analytic arguments cover the infinite quantifiers.

originality.rationale: The exact all-star iff statement is not implied by the previously known MINSUB sufficient condition (which supplies only the m<=3 direction), nor by the published existence of a graph counterexample (which supplies no all-star necessity). Explicit KKT witnesses for m=4,5 and an analytic parity-complete extension produce the previously unaccounted classification. Targeted public-literature and semantic-result searches did not identify an equivalent published statement; residual historical-priority risk remains.
residual_risks: An older or less-indexed equivalence of star fused-lasso regularization paths with gradient flow could subsume the classification.
The full JMLR fused-lasso paper and all historical fused-lasso paths were not exhaustively checked; no negative exclusion is claimed for unseen material.

value.rationale: This is a natural all-parameter classification of whether composing graph-TV proximal denoisers agrees with increasing the regularization scale, important for multi-stage smoothing. It identifies the exact first branching obstruction at a four-leaf star and provides self-contained rational counterexamples for all larger stars. It does not depend on a contrived single parameter value for its formulation or assert an unwarranted general graph theorem.
